action_items: test_termv_iter8.py must be run with '-n 0' (serial). When executed under the default xdist LoadScopeScheduling (2 workers), each worker runs the module-autouse fixture and its teardown deletes the shared partner sessions and can wipe seed enrollments while the other worker's test class is still executing — causing 401s and 400 'not enrolled' setup errors. Consider making the pytest.ini addopts less mandatory, or better isolate module-scoped shared-state fixtures (e.g., separate DB per worker, or move session-injection into a session-scoped fixture keyed by worker id).

apply_execution() for COURSE_SWAP does not sanity-check that the partner is not already enrolled in a give-course (only checks that initiator does not already have a wanted course). The submit_request validator likewise skips this. If a partner already holds one of the give-courses, executed would produce a duplicate/overwrite (the delete_one keyed on both course_id AND section_id may miss, then update_one upserts on course_id only). Add a symmetric check on submit.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py credit-sum branch (L579-610) correctly validates give/get set difference and sum of credits — good. However, it does not check partner-side conflicts on the give-courses (partner may already own a course the initiator is giving), which can silently overwrite the partner's existing section on execute.

admin_clear_trading (L1401-1405) is a hard delete_many with no dry-run/preview and no confirmation payload — this is a destructive irreversible admin op. UI safeguard (AlertDialog) is the only guard. Acceptable given admin-only, but consider soft-delete or audit-restorable snapshot.
server.py is now 1430 lines — modularisation strongly recommended (routers/student, routers/admin, routers/trading, services/execution, services/swaps). Existing iter7 comment carried forward.

swap_pairs helper (L424-427) cleanly bridges legacy vs new schema — the frontend fallback in RequestDetail.js/Notifications.js/MyRequests.js mirrors this — good. AdminSwaps.js uses non-null-safe `[r.swap.initiator_current]` when initiator_gives is absent; will render 'undefined undefined' if a legacy record has neither field — low risk since submit_request always fills gives now.

Notifications.js fallback for the partner's 'You give' path uses `s.swap.partner_current` (single) with no partner_gives array support. Currently the backend never stores partner_gives (partner's give = initiator's get = single item for credit-sum since credit-sum only allows multi on initiator side), so this is correct for the current spec — but if we later allow multi on partner side too, this line will silently truncate.

context_for_next_testing_agent: IMPORTANT: (1) test_termv_iter8.py MUST be run with '-n 0' (e.g. `pytest backend/tests/test_termv_iter8.py -n 0`). Default pytest.ini xdist 2-worker config causes race in module teardown. (2) For credit-sum swap tests choose a partner who does NOT already hold any give-course (PGP41409 works: has BPIM-J, no Algo.Invt/Beh.Fin). (3) Partner-response endpoint expects {action: 'accept'|'reject'}. (4) submit_request rejects credit-sum swap where give-sum != get-sum. (5) apply_execution for a swap performs delete_one on both students' source rows (keyed by course_id+section_id) then update_one upsert on target — no capacity/timetable enforcement at execute time. (6) The Notifications UI relies on GET /student/pending-swaps for the swap card (not just /notifications) — that endpoint returns the full request document including initiator_gives[]/initiator_gets[]. (7) Frontend calls use cookie session_token; set it via context.add_cookies before navigation.
rca of the issue: N/A (all tests passed after using -n 0). Non-fatal env note: initial xdist parallel run wiped PGP41071's Algo/Beh enrollments mid-suite when one worker's setup deleted-then-restore was interleaved with another worker's test needing those enrollments; restoring canonical rows and re-running with -n 0 resolved all failures.
